build.beforeBuildCommand: cd ../frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src *; font-src 'self' data: asset: filesystem: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net
